meta.desc: Muddy ginger-and-grey farm pig walks right up to the lens chewing watermelon, mouth open, tongue out, looking straight into camera (vertical phone shot).
meta.note: Only 2.2 s: the source cuts at 16.22 s and the pig bumps the lens after 18.5 s. Best 1.5 s: clip 0.0-1.5 (approach + chewing) or 0.4-1.9 (closest, tongue).
